name: Zionism
overview: Scripture reveals Zion as a divinely cherished place where the LORD’s presence dwells and His glory is revealed, as seen in Psalms 87:2 and 102:16. Zion is portrayed as the spiritual center from which God's law and word proceed, drawing many to learn and walk in His ways (Isaiah 2:3). The longing for Zion amid exile, expressed in Psalms 137:1, and the promise of God gathering His people back to their land (Ezekiel 36:24) underscore God's faithfulness to restore and bless His covenant people. Ultimately, Zion is honored as the holy city of the LORD, destined for exaltation and reverence (Isaiah 60:14).
